def self.fetch_trusted_comments(github_client:, repo:, number:, project:, max_comments: DEFAULT_MAX_COMMENTS)
  if max_comments <= 0
    return []
  end
  all_comments = github_client.issue_comments(repo, number)
  trusted = []
  all_comments.reverse_each { |c|
    unless project.trusted_github_user?(c.user&.login)
      next
    end
    trusted << c
    if trusted.size == max_comments
      break
    end
  }
  trusted.reverse
rescue GithubClient::Error
  []
end
